name: list_scalar_union_now_claimed
description: UNION BURN-DOWN — CLAIMED: a MULTI-ARM union as a LIST ELEMENT (list<Color enum | string>). BAML threads the previous element's winning arm into the next as ctx.union_variant_hint (coerce_array.rs, the only hint setter) and tries that arm FIRST in both the try_cast and lenient phases, taking it outright at score 0. coerceList / tryCastArray now carry that hint per element and the union coercers consult it, so per-element arm selection reproduces BAML's. Here 'other' matches no enum value so element 0 lands on the STRING arm, and the hint makes element 1 take the string arm too (a canonical enum token and its string spelling are the same bytes). want live-captured.
